proposal.reason: Primary change is in network transport/proxy behavior: NET send-credit TX head storage defaults to sender-local device memory, with new mapping/open/close lifecycle and connect handshake updates in src/transport/net.cc. transport is additionally required because src/transport/p2p.cc and shared proxy state add a new allocation-only P2P proxy-buffer path and ownership/cleanup flow used to provision that head storage. memory is additionally required because src/include/alloc.h introduces MEM_LEGACY allocation/free semantics and tracking differences (including untrack bypass), which changes allocator behavior beyond a pure call-site refactor.
